entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: Human nation on the Northern Plains of Ulgrotha, founded under Serra's guidance, with capital Onella.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Planeswalker who came to Ulgrotha around 3750 AR, encouraged peace, and became protector and goddess of Aysen.

entities.name: Onella
entities.description: First city and capital of Aysen, named after the first Abbot chosen by Serra.

entities.name: Border Gates of Aysen
entities.description: Gates separating Aysen from the rest of the Homelands, guarded by Abbey Gargoyles.

entities.name: Koskun Mountains
entities.description: Home of goblins that skirmished with the nomads.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Ruler of the Dark Barony beside Aysen.

entities.name: Serrans
entities.description: Aysenites who believe good and evil are absolute.

entities.name: Great War of Ulgrotha
entities.description: War after which few human survivors became nomads.

events.summary: After the Great War, human survivors become nomads and later war among themselves.
events.quote: Then came a time when the nomads were growing so numerous, they started to war amongst themselves.

events.summary: Serra arrives around 3750 AR, encourages peace and the founding of Onella; the country is named Aysen.
events.quote: She encouraged peace amongst the nomads, and the foundation of their first city

events.summary: Serra becomes protector and eventually goddess of Aysen.
events.quote: Serra became the protector and eventually goddess of Aysen.

events.summary: Dissatisfied citizens found the town of An-Havva and other pioneer towns.
events.quote: many of the dissatisfied citizens had founded the town of An-Havva and the other pioneer towns

relations.quote: Serra became the protector and eventually goddess of Aysen.
in the Northern Plains of Ulgrotha

relations.note: one of two divisions of thought
relations.quote: There are two major divisions in how people think in Aysen
